variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: let is immutable, var is mutable.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
let i = 1
let f = 2.0
let b = true
let s = "Text"

operators.title: Operators
operators.code:
let a = 5 + 3
let b = a * 2
let c = (a == b) and true

conditionals.title: Conditionals

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: C-style for loop and foreach loop.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Functions are defined with closures/lambdas syntax.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays are created using the array keyword.

maps.title: Maps
maps.code:
let m = map[["Key", 1]]
let val = m: get("Key")
maps.notes: Maps use nested arrays for initialization.

error_handling.title: Error Handling

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Golo provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Golo supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Golo provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Golo converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Golo represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Golo formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Golo branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Golo defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Golo iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Golo organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Golo stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Golo groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Golo tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Golo organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
